facts.fact: The Business Registration Service says name reservation and business registration are merged into one step, with three preferred names and the full application submitted online.
The article says Pesaflow is associated in Kenya with eCitizen and the Business Registration Service, with services to file applications, pay fees and retrieve documents online.

facts.fact: The Registrar of Companies' Directive No. 01 of 2024 requires all companies and LLPs to prepare a beneficial owners register and file a copy with the Registrar, with a penalty of Ksh 500,000 for failure.

The Business Registration Service says IFC support covered digitization of all Company Registry records, an electronic document management system and integration of the companies, e-collateral, hire purchase and Official Receiver registries.

The Business Registration Service says GIZ support led to an online Beneficial Ownership Information Register operationalised for private companies by 2020, with the Companies (Beneficial Ownership Information) Regulations 2020 being implemented.

Kenyans.co.ke reports the Business Registration Service launched its BRS Version II online portal on eCitizen on 16 February 2026 for company changes, and digital downloadable certificates have replaced physical ones.
